payload.title: Tue 12/1: Referring providers: progress notes as requested
payload.purpose: What a referring provider can ask for during the program, and how the registered nurse coordinates care.

captions.LI: Referring providers can request progress notes at any time during a patient's time in our intensive outpatient program. Our registered nurse coordinates care with medical providers to ensure continuity with any current treatment plans patients may have. We provide updates within two business days and, at discharge, a detailed summary of the patient's behavioral progress, including changes in assessment scores measuring nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, and depression, among other metrics. The Bariatric Counseling Center serves patients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas. The program can be standalone behavioral treatment for obesity, or in addition to bariatric surgery or weight loss medication that patients receive from their medical providers. #BehavioralHealth
captions.GBP: Referring providers can request progress notes at any time during a patient's enrollment at the Bariatric Counseling Center. Our registered nurse coordinates care with medical providers to ensure continuity with any current treatment plans. We provide updates within two business days. At patient discharge, referring providers receive a detailed summary of behavioral progress during the intensive outpatient program, including changes in assessment scores measuring nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, and depression, among other metrics. The staff is comprised of a clinical psychologist, licensed professional counselors, registered dietitians, movement therapists, and a registered nurse, as well as a professional chef. San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

payload.title: Tue 12/8: Referring providers: what comes back to you
payload.purpose: Coordination with the referring provider and the discharge summary of behavioral progress (assessment scores: nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, depression). LinkedIn document post, Todd's sentences verbatim.

captions.LI:
When you refer a patient to the Bariatric Counseling Center, you receive detailed communication throughout their treatment and a comprehensive summary at discharge.

Our team coordinates care with referring medical providers and, at patient discharge, we give referring providers a detailed summary of the patient's behavioral progress during the time in our intensive outpatient program, including changes in assessment scores measuring nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, and depression, among other metrics.

The program can be standalone behavioral treatment for obesity, or in addition to bariatric surgery or weight loss medication that patients receive from their medical providers.

The staff is comprised of a clinical psychologist, licensed professional counselors, registered dietitians, movement therapists, and a registered nurse, as well as a professional chef. One program, not four.

Serving patients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

#BehavioralHealth

payload.title: Thu 12/10: Virtual across Texas, on your calendar
payload.purpose: The virtual option for someone who travels for work or lives outside San Antonio.

captions.LI:
Many referring providers ask how our intensive outpatient program works for patients who travel for work or live outside the San Antonio area.

The answer is our virtual option. Patients can join sessions from anywhere in Texas, whether they are home in Houston, on the road in Dallas, or in a hotel room between meetings.

The Bariatric Counseling Center offers group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education in both virtual and onsite formats. Patients typically attend for little to no cost under their mental health benefits.

Our Director of Admissions is Leloni Gonzales at lgonzales@bccsanantonio.com and 210-634-2200. Program details are at bariatriccounselingcenter.com/program-schedule/.

#BehavioralHealth
